Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Malformed journal search response is rendered as a list of blank entries
   where: /journal (GET /api/journal?q=...)
   expected: An error saying the journal could not be loaded, with no fake entries
   saw: {"cards":["–","–","–","–"],"t":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","14 entries match","–","–","–","–","–","–"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-192314-hunt-a985/probes/journal-bad-responses-client.mjs (expectation "malformed-search-shows-error-not-entries")
2. HIGH   Malformed journal response on plant detail shows dozens of blank entries with Edit/Delete buttons
   where: /plants/:id Journal section (GET /api/journal?plant_id=...)
   expected: 'Could not load the journal.' alert
   saw: ["Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-192314-hunt-a985/probes/journal-bad-responses-client.mjs (expectation "malformed-detail-journal-shows-error")
3. HIGH   Non-list journal response is shown as 'No entries match'
   where: /journal search
   expected: An error, not an empty result
   saw: ["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","0 entries match","No entries match","Try a different word or plant name.","Clear search","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-192314-hunt-a985/probes/journal-bad-responses-client.mjs (expectation "empty-object-search-not-shown-as-no-match")
4. MEDIUM Journal search stays on 'Loading entries…' forever when the request hangs, while showing stale results
   where: /journal search
   expected: A timeout with an error and a way to retry
   saw: ["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","Loading entries…","Courgette","12 Nov 2026","Newest entry","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-192314-hunt-a985/probes/journal-bad-responses.mjs (expectation "hang-not-loading-forever")
